notes.selftest: dt5, 18 cases per set per arm (6/task): turbc15 all 12 arms bit-for-bit 18/18; kick classical, probe, snn11 s1,s2,s4,s5 18/18 and s3 17/18 (one row differs only in ref_abs_mean). Full 192-case HomePC dt5 re-run of kick learned arms: snn11 190-192/192 identical, all differing rows have identical crash outcome (score diffs <1e-3); mlp_ppo kick references (v14/kick__mlp_ppo_s*, produced on CloudPC-2) are NOT reproducible on HomePC (0/192 identical, crash counts within +/-2). dt5 kick references for snn11 and mlp_ppo therefore use the HomePC re-run (runs/spike_steer/q1/dt5/kick); classical, probe and all turbc15 dt5 rows are the stored references.
notes.rk4: dropped: not executable as specified. The plant steps through topology_hover/sensor_step.cpp, which splits mj_step into mj_step1/mj_step2; MuJoCo 3.8 mj_step2 has no RK4 path and falls back to Euler. Verified: opt.integrator=RK4 gives qpos bit-identical to Euler after 50 ticks. True RK4 would need a change to the native loop (and blade forces would still be held over the RK4 stages).
notes.nominal: dropped: dt10+dt2p5 on nominal plus a dt5 reproduction would push total past ~8 h.
notes.criterion_reading: The conjunctive criterion is False, but because (b) already fails at the dt5 reference (1/5 seeds; identical to plan_v16 R1 = 1 seed), and fails the same way at dt2p5 (0/5). (a) holds at all three steps (5/5). dt2p5 reproduces dt5 to within <=4 crashes per arm on both sets (5 us is converged); dt10 is not converged (+21..+45 crashes per arm on kick, +24..+36 on x1.5), and there (b) flips to 5/5 because the probe degrades most.
